name: Blank wall
en: Move away from the wall. Add one thing that belongs there: a lamp you can see in the shot, a shelf, or a light from the side.
hi: Wall se door aa jao. Koi cheez add karo jo wahan naturally ho: frame mein dikhne wala lamp, shelf, ya side se light.

name: Bright object merging with head
en: Shift the phone or yourself sideways until the bright object no longer looks joined to your head.
hi: Phone ko ya khud ko side mein shift karo jab tak woh bright cheez aapke sir se judi hui na dikhe.

name: Bright window in background
en: Turn the phone so the window is not straight behind you, close the curtain or use a see-through curtain to soften the light, or move into shade.
hi: Phone ko aise ghumao ki window seedha aapke peeche na ho, curtain band karo ya patla curtain lagao taaki light soft ho, ya shade mein chale jao.

name: Messy room/clutter
en: Move yourself or the phone until only a clean part of the room shows behind you. Remove or hide anything distracting.
hi: Khud ko ya phone ko tab tak shift karo jab tak peeche sirf room ka clean hissa dikhe. Distracting cheezein hata do ya chhupa do.

name: Mirror/glass reflection
en: Move the phone or the light a few degrees to the side, so the mirror or glass stops reflecting it.
hi: Phone ya light ko kuch degrees side mein ghumao, taaki mirror ya glass mein uska reflection na aaye.

name: Subject blends into background
en: Change how light or dark the background is, or how far you are from it, or add a light behind you.
hi: Background ka shade badlo (halka ya dark), ya usse apni doori badlo, ya apne peeche se light add karo.

name: What makes a bad background, and the fix
en: First move yourself or the phone so a clean area is behind you. Then switch off the room lights and light only your face with a focused desk lamp, so the background falls into shadow. If your phone has a telephoto (3x/3.5x), switch to it to narrow the view.
hi: Pehle khud ko ya phone ko shift karo taaki peeche clean jagah dikhe. Phir room ki lights band karke sirf face pe focused desk lamp ki light daalo, taaki background andhere mein chala jaaye. Agar aapke phone mein telephoto (3x/3.5x) hai, toh usse view narrow karo.

name: Eye-level
en: Keep the phone at your eye level. It gives a neutral view and easy eye contact, the best default for interviews, teaching and talking straight to camera.
hi: Phone apni eye level pe rakho. Isse neutral view aur achha eye contact milta hai; interviews, teaching aur camera se seedhi baat ke liye yeh best default hai.

name: Black, silhouetted face
en: Move so the window is beside you, not behind you. Or tap your face on the screen to lock the brightness there, then raise EV (the brightness slider) by +0.5 to +1.0.
hi: Aise shift ho jao ki window aapke side mein ho, peeche nahi. Ya screen pe apne face pe tap karke brightness wahan lock karo, phir EV (brightness slider) +0.5 se +1.0 tak badhao.

name: Choppy, laggy video in a dim room
en: Add a real light to the room. In low light your phone records fewer frames each second to catch more light, so the video looks choppy. If your camera app has a Pro video mode, lock the fps yourself, or use an app like Open Camera or Blackmagic Camera to lock it.
hi: Room mein asli light add karo. Kam light mein phone har second kam frames leta hai taaki zyada light pakde, isliye video atak-atak ke chalta hai. Agar aapke camera app mein Pro video mode hai, toh fps khud lock karo, ya Open Camera ya Blackmagic Camera jaisa app use karke lock karo.

name: Digital crop jitter / warping edges while walking
en: If your phone has OIS and the edges wobble while you walk at night, turn off 'Ultra Steady' (EIS) and let OIS alone keep the video steady.
hi: Agar aapke phone mein OIS hai aur raat ko chalte hue edges hil rahe hain, toh 'Ultra Steady' (EIS) off karo aur video steady rakhne ke liye sirf OIS pe chalo.

name: Distorted facial features (huge nose, tiny ears)
en: The phone is too close to your face. Move it farther than arm's length and reframe. If your phone has a telephoto, you can stay back and still frame tight.
hi: Phone aapke face ke bahut paas hai. Use arm's length se zyada door rakho aur frame phir se set karo. Agar aapke phone mein telephoto hai, toh aap door rehkar bhi tight frame le sakte ho.

name: India
en: If dark bands roll across the screen and your camera is auto only, switch off the flickering light or use daylight. If your camera app has a Pro video mode, indoors under home lights use 25fps at 1/50s, or 50fps at 1/100s (1/200s also works).
hi: Agar screen pe dark bands chal rahe hain aur camera sirf auto hai, toh flicker karne wali light band karo ya daylight use karo. Agar aapke camera app mein Pro video mode hai, toh ghar ki lights mein 25fps pe 1/50s, ya 50fps pe 1/100s rakho (1/200s bhi chalega).

name: Balcony door
en: Stand in the shade facing the open sky, and don't point the phone straight at the outside window. Otherwise your face comes out too dark against the bright outdoors.
hi: Shade mein khade ho jao, face khule aasmaan ki taraf, aur phone ko seedha bahar wali window pe point mat karo. Warna bright bahar ke saamne aapka face bahut dark aayega.

name: Bedroom
en: Turn so the window is 30-45 degrees to your face, sit away from the wall, and keep a dim warm lamp in the background. Watch for mixed daylight and warm bulbs, clutter on the bed and fan shadows.
hi: Aise baitho ki window aapke face se 30-45 degree pe ho, wall se door raho, aur background mein dim warm lamp rakho. Daylight aur warm bulb ka mix, bed pe clutter aur fan ki shadows check karo.

name: Desk/office
en: Put a soft main light just to the side of your monitor, and one lamp you can see behind you. Don't use the monitor as your only light, and check for glasses reflections and shelves lining up with your head.
hi: Soft main light monitor ke thoda side mein rakho, aur peeche frame mein dikhne wala lamp. Monitor ko akeli light mat banao, aur glasses mein reflection aur sir ke peeche shelves check karo.

name: Kitchen
en: Turn your face to one light you pick, and control the ceiling light and under-cabinet light separately. Watch for mixed light colours, shiny tiles and steel, and shadows from overhead lights.
hi: Jo light aapne chuni hai, usi ki taraf face karo, aur ceiling light aur cabinet ke neeche wali light ko alag-alag control karo. Mixed light colours, chamakti tiles aur steel, aur upar ki lights ki shadows check karo.

name: Living room
en: Use a window, or a panel light bounced off a wall, as your main light, with a lamp you can see in the background. Watch for bright windows, mirrors, shiny surfaces and uneven mixed LEDs.
hi: Main light ke liye window use karo, ya panel light ko wall se bounce karo, aur background mein dikhne wala lamp rakho. Bright windows, mirrors, chamakti surfaces aur uneven mixed LEDs check karo.

name: Night market
en: Keep the main light for your face near the phone, and let the shop lights and lamps stay behind you. Watch for flicker, mixed colours and bright signs turning pure white.
hi: Face ki main light phone ke paas rakho, aur dukaan ki lights aur lamps peeche rehne do. Flicker, mixed colours aur pure white ho jaane wale bright signs check karo.

name: Rooftop/beach
en: Keep the low sun to your side or behind you, lighting your edges, and turn your face toward the open sky or a reflector. Watch for squinting, bright sky or water, wind and the fast change at sunset.
hi: Low sun ko apni side ya peeche rakho taaki edges chamkein, aur face khule aasmaan ya reflector ki taraf rakho. Aankhein sikodna, bright sky ya paani, hawa aur sunset ka tez badlaav check karo.

name: Street/campus/market
en: Stay in shade from an awning, building or tree the whole time, and find a darker background. Watch for patchy sunlight, signs, reflections in cars and glass, and people moving behind you.
hi: Poore time awning, building ya ped ki shade mein raho, aur peeche darker background dhoondo. Patchy dhoop, signs, cars aur glass ke reflections, aur peeche chalte log check karo.

name: Ceiling LED/tube/fan light
en: If the ceiling light is your only light, it lights you from above and puts dark shadows on your face. Move to a window or a wall bounce, add a soft light next to your phone, or switch it off if you have another main light. Just lowering the phone won't fix it.
hi: Agar ceiling light hi aapki akeli light hai, toh woh upar se aati hai aur face pe dark shadows daalti hai. Window ke paas jao ya wall se bounce karo, phone ke paas soft light lagao, ya koi aur main light ho toh ise off karo. Sirf phone neeche karne se theek nahi hoga.

name: Kitchen/corridor mixed lights
en: Kitchens and corridors often mix warm and cool lights. Pick one light colour for your face and switch off the ones that clash, or keep them in the background as a planned touch of colour.
hi: Kitchen aur corridor mein aksar warm aur cool lights mix hoti hain. Face ke liye warm ya cool mein se koi colour chuno aur clash karne wali lights off karo, ya unhe background mein jaanboojhkar colour accent ki tarah rakho.

name: Ring light
en: A ring light next to your phone lights your face evenly, but it can look flat and show up as a ring reflection in glasses. Raise it a little or move it to the side of the phone for more shape, and check the reflection.
hi: Phone ke paas ring light face ko evenly light karti hai, par look flat ho sakta hai aur glasses mein ring ka reflection dikh sakta hai. Ise thoda upar karo ya phone ki side mein le jao taaki shape aaye, aur reflection check karo.

name: TV/display as light source
en: A TV or screen changes the brightness and colour on your face as the picture changes. Use it only as a background mood light, never as your only main light.
hi: TV ya screen pe jo chal raha hai uske saath face ki brightness aur colour bhi badalte rehte hain. Ise sirf background mood light ki tarah use karo, apni akeli main light mat banao.

name: Warm bulb/table/floor lamp
en: Keep the lamp in the shot as a warm background light, or bounce it off a pale wall or ceiling. A small bare bulb makes sharp shadows. Leave safe space around it, and never cover a hot lamp with cloth.
hi: Lamp ko shot mein warm background light ki tarah dikhne do, ya uski light pale wall ya ceiling se bounce karo. Chhota khula bulb sharp shadows banata hai. Uske aas-paas safe jagah chhodo, aur garam lamp ko kabhi kapde se mat dhako.

name: Window/balcony daylight
en: Window or balcony daylight is often your most useful big light. Make it your main light, at your side or in front of you and a little to the side. Switch off room lights that clash with a clearly different colour.
hi: Window ya balcony ki daylight aksar aapki sabse useful badi light hoti hai. Ise apni main light banao, side mein ya saamne thoda side se. Jo room lights saaf alag colour ki hon aur clash karein, unhe off karo.

name: Behind, ~120-180 deg (backlight)
en: A light behind you (about 120-180 degrees) only lights your edges or makes a silhouette; on its own it won't light your face. Keep it a little out of line with the lens to avoid glare, and light your face with the sky, a reflector or a small lamp in front.
hi: Peeche se aati light (about 120-180 degree) sirf aapke edges chamkati hai ya silhouette banati hai; akele woh face ko light nahi karti. Use lens ki seedhi line se thoda hata ke rakho taaki glare na aaye, aur face ke liye saamne se sky, reflector ya chhota lamp use karo.

name: Below face
en: Keep the phone at your normal height; don't lower it to make a light from below look natural. Light from below gives a spooky, stage-like look, so avoid it for professional videos unless it clearly comes from a screen or desk lamp in the scene.
hi: Phone apni normal height pe rakho; neeche se aati light ko natural dikhane ke liye phone neeche mat karo. Neeche se aati light spooky, stage jaisa look deti hai, isliye professional videos mein avoid karo, jab tak woh scene mein screen ya desk lamp se aati na dikhe.

name: Directly overhead
en: A light straight above you puts dark shadows on your face. Raising or lowering the phone won't fix it: move yourself or the light, bounce light back onto your face with something white, or move into open shade (shade with open sky in front of you).
hi: Seedha upar se aati light face pe dark shadows daalti hai. Phone upar-neeche karne se yeh theek nahi hoga: khud ko ya light ko shift karo, kisi white cheez se light face pe wapas bounce karo, ya open shade mein jao (shade jahan saamne khula aasmaan ho).

name: Near camera axis, 0-15 deg
en: When your main light is almost straight in front of you (0-15 degrees), keep the phone close to the line of that light, but don't sit too close to the phone. Check for reflections in glasses and too-bright spots of light on your face.
hi: Jab aapki main light lagbhag seedha saamne ho (0-15 degree), phone ko usi light ki line ke paas rakho, par phone ke bahut paas mat baitho. Glasses mein reflection aur face pe zyada bright spots check karo.

name: Side, near 90 deg
en: Light from directly at your side (near 90 degrees) gives strong light and shadow, for a dramatic or documentary look. With the phone in front, turn your face toward the light for more light, away for more shadow. For an even look, add a softer light on the other side.
hi: Seedha side se aati light (lagbhag 90 degree) strong light aur shadow deti hai, dramatic ya documentary look ke liye. Phone saamne rakho; zyada roshni ke liye face light ki taraf ghumao, zyada shadow ke liye door. Even look ke liye doosri side softer light lagao.

name: Slight side, ~15-30 deg
en: For a natural talking video, start with your main light slightly to the side, about 15-30 degrees. Keep the phone straight in front of you; for a little more shadow, move it just toward the darker side of your face.
hi: Natural talking video ke liye main light thoda side mein rakho, about 15-30 degree. Phone seedha aapke saamne rakho; thoda aur shadow chahiye toh phone ko halka sa face ke andhere wale side ki taraf le jao.

name: Three-quarter side, ~30-60 deg
en: For a serious interview look, put your main light about 30-60 degrees to the side. Keep the phone in front, nudged toward the light for a brighter look or toward the shadow side for more shadow. If the eye on the side away from the light goes dark, add a softer light on the other side.
hi: Serious interview look ke liye main light about 30-60 degree side mein rakho. Phone saamne rakho, brighter look ke liye thoda light ki taraf, zyada shadow ke liye shadow side ki taraf. Light se door wali side ki aankh dark ho jaaye toh doosri side softer light lagao.

name: Close-up shot on a very wide camera held close to your face
en: Move the phone farther away and use the main 1x camera. Keep your face near the centre and reframe. If your phone has a real optical telephoto, you can use that instead.
hi: Phone ko door le jao aur main 1x camera use karo. Face ko centre ke paas rakho aur frame phir se set karo. Agar aapke phone mein asli optical telephoto hai, toh woh bhi use kar sakte ho.

name: Lights of different colours are falling on your face
en: Pick the light you want on your face, and switch the others off or keep them only in the background. If your camera app has a Pro video mode, set white balance for that face light.
hi: Face ke liye light chuno, baaki lights band karo ya sirf background mein rakho. Agar aapke camera app mein Pro video mode hai, toh white balance us face light ke hisaab se set karo.

name: The background behind you is distracting
en: Move the phone or move yourself before you zoom in or switch lenses. Moving changes what's behind you directly.
hi: Zoom karne ya lens badalne se pehle phone ko ya khud ko move karo. Move karne se peeche ka scene seedha badal jaata hai.

name: The light is too hard, or too soft and flat
en: If the light is too hard, make it bigger: shine it through a see-through curtain, bounce it off a pale wall, or move into shade. If it's too soft and flat, cut the light on the shadow side, or use a smaller main light placed more to the side.
hi: Light bahut hard hai toh use bada banao: patle parde se guzaro, halki rang ki wall se bounce karo, ya shade mein jao. Bahut soft aur flat hai toh shadow side ki light kam karo, ya chhoti main light zyada side mein rakho.

name: The main light is directly overhead (ceiling light or high sun)
en: Move yourself or the light, or bounce light up from low in front of you with a white card or sheet. Tilting or lowering the phone doesn't fix the lighting.
hi: Khud ko ya light ko move karo, ya saamne neeche se white card ya sheet se light upar bounce karo. Phone ko tilt karna ya neeche karna lighting ka fix nahi hai.

name: Wide shot that shows the whole room or location
en: Check the whole frame, every light, window and corner of the background, not just your face. A fix that works for your face may not cover the room behind you.
hi: Sirf face nahi, poora frame check karo: har light, window aur background ka har kona. Jo fix face ke liye chalta hai, woh peeche ke room ko cover na kare, aisa ho sakta hai.

name: You are moving on camera in low light
en: Add a steady light that stays on, and keep the phone stable, before you count on Night mode. Night mode can take several seconds per shot, so movement blurs.
hi: Night mode pe bharosa karne se pehle steady light lagao jo on rahe, aur phone stable rakho. Night mode ko har shot mein kaafi seconds lag sakte hain, isliye movement blur ho jaati hai.

name: You are squinting, or direct sun is throwing hard, uncomfortable shadows on your face
en: Move into full shade, or turn away from the direct sun, before you touch the brightness. Changing brightness on the phone won't remove squinting or hard sun shadows.
hi: Brightness badalne se pehle poori shade mein jao, ya seedhi dhoop se muh pher lo. Phone pe brightness badalne se aankhein sikodna ya dhoop ke hard shadows nahi jaate.

name: Your face is dark against a bright window or sky
en: Change where the phone points, or what's behind you, so the bright window or sky isn't behind your head. Or add light on your face with a lamp or a white card bouncing light back. Don't just make the whole picture darker.
hi: Phone ka direction ya apna background badlo, taaki bright window ya sky aapke sar ke peeche na ho. Ya lamp se, ya white card se light wapas bounce karke face pe light daalo. Poori picture ko bas dark mat karo.

name: Documentary / expert / founder
en: Use the window or light already in your room as your main light, so it looks natural. Let the real bits of your space show. If your face looks flat, put something dark, like a dark cloth, on the side away from the light.
hi: Room mein jo window ya light pehle se hai, usi ko main light banao taaki natural lage. Apni asli jagah ki cheezein frame mein dikhne do. Face flat lage toh light se door wali side pe kuch dark rakho, jaise dark kapda.

name: Friendly / natural
en: Sit close to a big, soft light in front of you and a little to the side, like a window, or open shade outdoors. Keep shadows soft and the background tidy but lived-in. Go warm only if a warm light in the shot explains it.
hi: Saamne aur thoda side mein badi soft light ke paas baitho, jaise window, ya bahar open shade. Shadows soft rakho aur background saaf par lived-in. Warm look tabhi rakho jab shot mein koi warm light usko explain kare.

name: High-key
en: Light the background brightly but under control, and light yourself brightly too, with few hard dark shadows. Watch that the brightest parts of your face don't turn pure white.
hi: Background ko bright par control mein rakho, aur khud pe bhi bright light rakho, hard dark shadows kam hon. Dhyan rakho ki face ke sabse bright hisse bilkul white na ho jaayein.

name: Low-key / dramatic
en: Put your main light at your side or edge, with little light on the other side and a darker background. Put a dark cloth or wall on the shadow side of your face. Don't lose your far eye in the dark by accident.
hi: Main light ko apne side ya edge pe rakho, opposite side pe kam light aur background dark. Face ki shadow side pe dark kapda ya dark wall rakho. Dhyan rakho ki door wali aankh galti se andhere mein na kho jaaye.

name: Serious / educational
en: Put a soft main light 30 to 45 degrees to your side, a little above your eyes, with only a little light on the other side. Turn your face slightly toward it, keep the phone steady at eye level, and keep the background a bit darker than you.
hi: Soft main light ko apne side mein 30 to 45 degrees pe rakho, aankhon se thoda upar, aur opposite side pe bas thodi si light. Face thoda light ki taraf ghumao, phone eye level pe steady rakho, aur background aapse thoda dark rakho.

name: Silhouette
en: Put a bright background or light behind you, let the phone set its brightness for that bright part, and keep light off your face. Keep your outline clean against the bright area.
hi: Apne peeche bright background ya light rakho, phone ki brightness usi bright hisse ke hisaab se set hone do, aur face pe light mat daalo. Bright area ke against apni outline saaf rakho.

name: Backlit subject (bright shop or sunset behind them)
en: If you can, move so the bright shop or sunset is not right behind you. If not, tap your face and push brightness up (+EV) until your face is bright enough; don't worry about the background. If your phone has an HDR video mode, use it to balance the strong contrast.
hi: Ho sake toh jagah badlo taaki bright shop ya sunset seedha aapke peeche na ho. Nahi ho sake toh face pe tap karke brightness (+EV) badhao jab tak face bright na ho jaaye, background ki fikar mat karo. Agar aapke phone mein HDR video mode hai, toh use on karo taaki strong contrast balance ho.

name: Cloudy or overcast day
en: Clouds give a big soft light with gentle shadows, good for your face. Add colour or texture in the background, and tap your face to lock brightness so the white sky doesn't make you dark. If your camera app has a Pro video mode, lock white balance around 6000-6500K to warm the flat, bluish look.
hi: Baadal soft light dete hain, halki shadows, face pe achhi. Background mein colour ya texture rakho; face pe tap karke brightness lock karo taaki white sky aapko dark na kare. Agar aapke camera app mein Pro video mode hai, toh white balance lagbhag 6000-6500K pe lock karo, bluish look warm hoga.

name: Golden hour (about the first hour after sunrise and the last hour before sunset)
en: The softest, warmest outdoor light. Face the sun at an angle for a warm glow, or keep it behind you for a bright outline. It changes fast: shoot all the shots of one reel within about 20 minutes. If your camera app has a Pro video mode, lock white balance so colour doesn't jump between shots.
hi: Sabse soft, warm outdoor light. Warm glow ke liye sun ki taraf angle pe face karo, ya bright outline ke liye sun peeche rakho. Light jaldi badalti hai: reel ke saare shots lagbhag 20 minutes mein le lo. Agar aapke camera app mein Pro video mode hai, toh white balance lock karo taaki colour na badle.

name: Harsh midday sun (sun high, your shadow short and right under you)
en: Move into open shade, like a building's or tree's shadow with open sky in front of you, for soft, even light on your face. Stuck in the sun? Hold a white sheet, dupatta or thermocol board low in front of you to bounce light up onto your face, then tap your face to lock brightness and raise it a bit.
hi: Open shade mein jao, jaise building ya ped ki shade jahan saamne khula aasmaan ho, taaki face pe soft, even light aaye. Dhoop mein hi ho? White sheet, dupatta ya thermocol board neeche saamne pakdo taaki light upar face pe bounce ho, phir face pe tap karke brightness lock karo aur thoda badhao.

name: Mixed indoor LED (warm bulb + cool tube light — common in Indian apartments)
en: Pick one light for your face: a window, a lamp or a ring light. Not the ceiling light alone, because it lights you from straight above. Switch off the lights that clash with it, or keep them only in the background.
hi: Face ke liye apni main light chuno: window, lamp ya ring light. Sirf ceiling light pe mat raho, woh seedha upar se light karti hai. Jo lights uske saath clash karein unhe off karo, ya sirf background mein rakho.

name: Shade under trees
en: Sunlight through leaves makes bright spots on your face, so step to where the shade is even, with no sun spots on you. Light bouncing off leaves can turn the light on your face green, so face open sky or a light-coloured wall. If your camera app has a Pro video mode, lock white balance.
hi: Patton se aati dhoop face pe bright spots banati hai; wahan khade ho jahan shade even ho. Patton se bounce hoti light face pe green tint de sakti hai, toh khule aasmaan ya light-coloured wall ki taraf face karo. Agar aapke camera app mein Pro video mode hai, toh white balance lock karo.

name: Soft natural window light
en: Sit or stand at about 30-45 degrees to the window, with the window out of the shot at your side. Take this angle as a starting point. Tap the lit side of your face to set brightness, and let the other side fall into soft shadow for a film-like look.
hi: Window se lagbhag 30-45 degrees ke angle pe baitho ya khade ho, aur window frame ke bahar side mein rahe. Is angle ko starting point samjho. Face ki lit side pe tap karke brightness set karo, aur dusri side ko halki shadow mein rehne do, look cinematic lagega.

name: Strong natural daylight (terrace/street), when the sun is low or at an angle, not overhead
en: Keep the sun behind you or to your side, so it outlines you against the background. Bounce light onto your face with a reflector or a light-coloured wall. If your camera app has a Pro video mode, lock the lowest ISO; with no ND filter, use a faster shutter so bright areas don't burn out.
hi: Sun ko apne peeche ya side mein rakho, taaki woh aapko background se alag outline de. Reflector ya light-coloured wall se face pe light bounce karo. Agar aapke camera app mein Pro video mode hai, toh lowest ISO lock karo; ND filter nahi hai toh faster shutter lo, taaki bright parts white na ho.

name: Cool ceiling LED + warm bulb
en: Light your face with the warm bulb (or a window) and switch the ceiling LED off. If the ceiling light is the only light you have, switch off the warm bulb and hold a white card or sheet low in front of you to bounce light up onto your face.
hi: Face ke liye warm bulb (ya window) use karo aur ceiling LED off karo. Agar aapke paas sirf ceiling light hai, toh warm bulb off karo aur white card ya sheet neeche saamne pakdo taaki light upar face pe bounce ho.

name: Phone auto white balance shifts during the take
en: Lock or set white balance if your phone allows it. If your phone can't, cut down the clashing light colours, and don't walk through areas lit by different colours during the shot.
hi: Agar aapka phone allow kare, toh white balance lock ya set karo. Agar phone mein yeh nahi hai, toh alag-alag colour ki lights kam karo, aur shot ke dauraan alag colour ki lights wali jagahon se mat guzro.

name: Sunset into blue hour
en: Lock white balance if your phone allows it, so your shots match, or change it on purpose once between scenes. Add a steady light on your face as the daylight drops.
hi: Agar aapka phone allow kare, toh white balance lock karo taaki shots match karein, ya scenes ke beech jaan-boojhkar badlo. Daylight kam hote hi face pe steady light add karo.

name: Two daylight windows
en: Use the brighter window as your face light. If the other window throws shadows in a different direction, close its curtain or cover it.
hi: Jo window zyada bright hai, use apni face light banao. Dusri window alag direction mein shadows daale toh uska curtain band karo ya use cover karo.

name: Window daylight + warm room lamp
en: Use the window as your face light. Switch the lamp off, or move it behind you as a warm lamp in the background. If your phone lets you lock white balance, lock it on your face and keep the lamp behind you warm if you like that look. If your phone can't, switch the lamp off.
hi: Window ko apni face light banao. Lamp off karo, ya use apne peeche background mein warm lamp ki tarah rakho. Agar aapka phone white balance lock karne deta hai, toh use face pe lock karo aur peeche wala lamp warm rakho agar aapko woh look pasand hai. Agar phone mein yeh nahi hai, toh lamp off karo.

name: Always wipe the camera lens with a microfiber cloth before recording — micro-scratches and finger oil cause severe highlight halation, worsened by humidity and dust common in Indian outdoor environments.
en: Always wipe your phone's camera lens with a microfiber cloth before you record. Tiny scratches and finger oil make bright lights glow and smear, and humidity and dust outdoors in India make it worse.
hi: Record karne se pehle hamesha camera lens ko microfiber cloth se pochho. Chhote scratches aur ungliyon ka oil bright lights ko glow aur smear karwa dete hain, aur India mein bahar ki humidity aur dust isse aur bura kar dete hain.

name: In video, stay on the phone's optical lenses (the 0.5x ultrawide, the 1x, and the 2x/3x/3.5x telephoto if the phone has them) and never zoom digitally past them -- move the phone closer instead; digital zoom throws away detail.
en: In video, stay on your phone's real lenses, like the 1x, and never zoom digitally past them; move the phone closer instead, because digital zoom throws away detail. If your phone has a 0.5x ultrawide, that is a real lens too. If your phone has a 2x/3x/3.5x telephoto, that is a real lens too.
hi: Video mein phone ke asli lenses pe hi raho, jaise 1x, aur unke aage digital zoom mat karo; phone paas le aao, kyunki digital zoom detail kho deta hai. Agar aapke phone mein 0.5x ultrawide hai, toh woh bhi asli lens hai. Agar aapke phone mein 2x/3x/3.5x telephoto hai, toh woh bhi asli lens hai.

name: Keep ISO as low as you can; if you see grain, add light rather than raising ISO (roughly above 800 on mid-range phones, 1600 on 1-inch sensors).
en: Keep ISO as low as you can. If the video looks grainy (roughly above ISO 800 on mid-range phones, 1600 on phones with a 1-inch sensor), add light rather than raising ISO.
hi: ISO jitna ho sake utna low rakho. Agar video grainy dikhe (mid-range phones pe roughly ISO 800 ke upar, 1-inch sensor wale phones pe 1600 ke upar), toh ISO badhane ki jagah light badhao.

name: On a phone with Pro/manual video, lock white balance to a Kelvin value for talking-head videos (about 5600K for daylight, 3200K for warm bulbs) -- auto white balance can shift skin tone mid-video as hands or a screen change colour. On an auto-only phone, use one light source so auto white balance has nothing to chase.
en: If your camera app has a Pro video mode, lock white balance for talking videos: about 5600K in daylight, 3200K under warm bulbs. Auto white balance can shift colours mid-video as your hands or a screen change colour. On an auto-only phone, use one light source so colour stays steady.
hi: Agar aapke camera app mein Pro video mode hai, talking videos ke liye white balance lock karo: daylight mein about 5600K, warm bulbs mein 3200K. Auto white balance haath ya screen ke colour se video ke beech colours badal sakta hai. Auto-only phone pe lights mix mat karo, taaki colour steady rahe.

name: Backlight/rim
en: Put a light behind you, off to the side. If you need detail on your face, add light from the phone's side. Keep that back light out of line with the lens, and watch for flare and stray light spilling onto you.
hi: Light ko apne peeche, thoda side mein rakho. Face pe detail chahiye toh phone ki side se light add karo. Peeche wali light lens ki line mein na aaye, aur flare aur aap pe girti extra light pe nazar rakho.

name: Rembrandt-style
en: Put your main light about 30-45 degrees to your side and above your face. Turn your face slightly away until a small triangle of light shows on the far side of your face. Check it on the phone screen; the angle alone won't promise it.
hi: Main light ko apne side mein lagbhag 30-45 degree pe aur face se upar rakho. Face thoda light se door ghumao, jab tak face ki door wali side pe chhota triangle of light na dikhe. Phone screen pe check karo, sirf angle se guarantee nahi hai.

name: Split
en: Put your main light near 90 degrees to your side. Face the phone straight, or turn until the line between light and shadow on your face looks the way you want. It's strong contrast, so add some light on the dark side if it loses detail you need.
hi: Main light ko apne side mein lagbhag 90 degree pe rakho. Phone ki taraf seedha dekho, ya tab tak ghumo jab tak face pe light aur shadow ki line waise na dikhe jaisi aap chahte ho. Contrast strong hai, toh dark side pe detail chahiye toh thodi light add karo.

name: Product demonstration (tech/cosmetics)
en: Keep the phone at your eye level while you talk. Tilt it slightly down toward your hands only for the product close-up, so things you hold at chest level look clear.
hi: Baat karte waqt phone aapki eye level pe rakho. Sirf product close-up ke liye phone ko thoda neeche apne haathon ki taraf tilt karo, taaki chest level pe pakdi cheezein clear dikhein.

name: Talking-head (educational/vlog)
en: Frame yourself from the chest up, phone at your eye level, with about two fingers of space above your head. On the 1x lens, keep the phone about 0.8-1m away. If your phone has a 3x telephoto and the room allows, use it from 2-2.5m instead.
hi: Chest se upar tak frame karo, phone aapki eye level pe, aur sir ke upar about two fingers jitni jagah chhodo. 1x lens pe phone lagbhag 0.8-1m door rakho. Agar aapke phone mein 3x telephoto hai aur room mein jagah hai, toh usse 2-2.5m se shoot karo.

name: 1. Low sun
en: Pick your look: sun on your face, sun behind your shoulder as a rim of light, or a silhouette. If the sun is on your face, keep it out of your eyes so you don't squint. For the rim look, face the open sky or a white card on the phone's side.
hi: Apna look chuno: dhoop face pe, dhoop kandhe ke peeche rim light ki tarah, ya silhouette. Dhoop face pe hai toh aankhon mein na pade, taaki aankhein na sikodo. Rim look ke liye open sky ki taraf ya phone ki side rakhe white card ki taraf muh karo.

name: 2. Sun near the horizon
en: Shift the phone a little so the sun isn't in line with the lens, unless you want flare or a silhouette. If the rim of light disappears, reframe against a darker background.
hi: Phone thoda shift karo taaki suraj lens ki line mein na ho, jab tak aapko flare ya silhouette na chahiye. Rim light gayab ho jaaye toh darker background ke against frame phir se set karo.

name: 3. Falling daylight
en: Bring a soft light closer to your face, or move to a brighter spot. Don't trust the phone to keep the picture clean on its own; expect grain and motion blur.
hi: Soft light ko face ke paas lao, ya kisi brighter jagah pe shift ho jao. Yeh mat socho ki phone khud picture clean rakhega; grain aur motion blur aayega.

name: 4. Blue hour
en: Keep the phone steady and use the main camera. Light your face from near the phone, and let far-off lamps and signs turn into points of light behind you.
hi: Phone steady rakho aur main camera use karo. Face pe light phone ke paas se daalo, aur door ke lamps aur signs ko peeche light ke points ban jaane do.

name: 5. Dark
en: If you move on camera, add a steady light that stays on. Night mode needs the phone held still for several seconds, so it can't replace real light when you move.
hi: Camera pe move kar rahe ho toh steady light lagao jo on rahe. Night mode ko phone kaafi seconds tak still chahiye, isliye movement ho toh woh asli light ki jagah nahi le sakta.

name: Creator faces window; phone between creator and window
en: Keep the window behind your phone or out of the shot. If your face looks flat, turn yourself 10-25 degrees toward the window and test what works. Check the glass for reflections.
hi: Window ko phone ke peeche ya frame ke bahar rakho. Agar face flat lage, toh khud ko window ki taraf 10-25 degree ghumao aur test karo. Glass mein reflections check karo.

name: Creator is 30-45 deg to window
en: Stand near the window with your face turned partway toward it, and keep the phone in front of you. Stay about 1-2m from the background as a starting point. If your face looks too flat, put a dark cloth or dark wall on the side away from the window.
hi: Window ke paas khade ho, face thoda window ki taraf ghumao, aur phone aapke saamne rahe. Starting point ke liye background se lagbhag 1-2m door raho. Face zyada flat lage toh window ki opposite side pe dark kapda ya dark wall rakho.

name: Creator is 90 deg to window
en: Keep the phone in front of you. Turn a little toward or away from the window to choose how much of your face is lit and how much is in shadow. If your eye on the far side goes dark, put a white sheet or board on that side to bounce light back.
hi: Phone aapke saamne rahe. Window ki taraf ya usse thoda door ghumkar decide karo ki face ka kitna hissa lit ho aur kitna shadow mein. Agar door wali side ki aankh dark ho jaaye, toh us side white sheet ya board rakho taaki light bounce ho.

name: Multiple windows
en: Make the brightest window your main light. If the other windows throw shadows that clash with it, curtain or cover them. Then set brightness so your face and the background both look right in the shot you want.
hi: Sabse bright window ko apni main light banao. Baaki windows ki shadows clash karein toh unpe curtain lagao ya cover karo. Phir brightness aise set karo ki aapke shot mein face aur background dono sahi dikhein.

name: Window above creator
en: Move out of the light falling straight down from the window, bounce light onto your face from in front of you and a little to the side, or turn to a lower window at your side. Tilting the phone won't fix light that comes from above.
hi: Window se seedhi neeche girti light se hat jao, saamne aur thoda side se face pe light bounce karo, ya side mein kisi neeche wali window ki taraf mud jao. Phone tilt karne se upar se aati light theek nahi hogi.

name: Window behind creator toward phone
en: Change where the phone points so the window moves to the side, close or cover the curtain, or add your own light on your face. Don't just make the whole video darker, or your face can turn into a dark shape. Wide shots are the hardest here.
hi: Phone ka direction badlo taaki window side mein aa jaaye, curtain band ya cover karo, ya face pe apni light lagao. Poore video ko bas dark mat karo, warna face dark shape ban sakta hai. Yahan wide shots sabse mushkil hote hain.

name: Window beside creator
en: Control the shadow side of your face: bounce light off a wall to soften it, or use a dark cloth or wall on that side. Make sure no equally bright window pane in the background sits right behind your head and blends in.
hi: Face ki shadow side ko control karo: wall se light bounce karke usse halka karo, ya us side dark kapda ya wall rakho. Dhyan do ki background mein utna hi bright window pane aapke head ke theek peeche na ho, warna dono mil jaate hain.
